units.summary: Adds a package-level test hook that compactHeadViewLocked calls once (then clears) between writing the blocks and evicting the series. In production it is nil, so nothing runs.
units.headline: New package-level test hook called before eviction
units.reason: Test-only hook that is nil in production; it only changes behavior when a test sets it.

units.summary: New function type for building a restricted BlockReader over the head for one chunk-range slice. It is only a type declaration; the behavior lives in compactHeadViewLocked.
units.headline: New headViewFactory type for restricted head block views
units.reason: Type declaration used only by the new internal helper; it adds no logic.

units.summary: New evictor function type that takes maxt and an append-ID watermark. Its doc comment states the contract evictors must follow (never evict series that received samples after compaction began). That contract is what the helper's correctness rests on.
units.headline: New headSeriesEvictor type documenting append-ID watermark contract
units.reason: Type declaration with docs; any behavior risk sits in compactHeadViewLocked and the evictors.

units.summary: Generalizes the old stale-head compaction loop: it writes one block per chunk-range slice for the given view, skips reload when Write returns no ULIDs, then evicts using an append-ID watermark captured before the writes. Empty slices are now skipped quietly, and the watermark guard is new.

issues.title: Watermark misses appenders opened before capture but committed later
issues.failure_scenario: An appender gets appendID N before compaction starts (it is still open, so the block writer's isolation state hides its samples), then commits sample t<=maxt after the blocks are written. Its appendID N <= watermark, so hasAppendIDAbove returns false and the series is evicted with a WAL tombstone. The sample is in neither the block nor the head, and is lost on replay.
issues.detail: lastAppendID returns the highest appendID issued, including appends that are still open. The comment 'blocks are guaranteed to contain all samples with appendID <= watermark' fails for open appenders, because the block reader's isolation snapshot excludes them.

units.headline: Shared head-view compaction loop with append-ID eviction watermark
units.reason: New compaction/eviction logic that deletes data from the head; a race here causes data loss.
focus: Open appenders whose appendID <= watermark that commit after the block snapshot: are they still evicted?
gcSeries does not check pendingCommit, unlike regular gc
Using the global chunkRange for slices vs opts.ChunkRange for mint alignment
Callers holding db.cmtx; the test hook is global and not synchronized

units.summary: CompactStaleHead now delegates to compactHeadViewLocked, using a SelectedSeriesHead view and truncateStaleSeries with the watermark. Changes: no log line is written for empty slices, and the eviction predicate now also skips series with post-watermark appends.
units.headline: CompactStaleHead refactored onto shared helper with watermark guard
units.reason: Eviction predicate and loop behavior changed for an existing public compaction path.
focus: truncateStaleSeries predicate (no OOO, stale, no appendID above the watermark) matches the old gcStaleSeries semantics
Error text changed from 'persist stale head' to 'persist head portion'

units.summary: Adds a package-level test hook that compactHeadViewLocked calls once (then clears) between writing the blocks and evicting the series. In production it is nil, so nothing runs.
units.headline: New package-level test hook called before eviction
units.reason: Test-only hook that is nil in production; it only changes behavior when a test sets it.

units.summary: New function type for building a restricted BlockReader over the head for one chunk-range slice. It is only a type declaration; the behavior lives in compactHeadViewLocked.
units.headline: New headViewFactory type for restricted head block views
units.reason: Type declaration used only by the new internal helper; it adds no logic.

units.summary: New evictor function type that takes maxt and an append-ID watermark. Its doc comment states the contract evictors must follow (never evict series that received samples after compaction began). That contract is what the helper's correctness rests on.
units.headline: New headSeriesEvictor type documenting append-ID watermark contract
units.reason: Type declaration with docs; any behavior risk sits in compactHeadViewLocked and the evictors.

units.summary: Generalizes the old stale-head compaction loop: it writes one block per chunk-range slice for the given view, skips reload when Write returns no ULIDs, then evicts using an append-ID watermark captured before the writes. Empty slices are now skipped quietly, and the watermark guard is new.

issues.title: Watermark misses appenders opened before capture but committed later
issues.failure_scenario: An appender gets appendID N before compaction starts (it is still open, so the block writer's isolation state hides its samples), then commits sample t<=maxt after the blocks are written. Its appendID N <= watermark, so hasAppendIDAbove returns false and the series is evicted with a WAL tombstone. The sample is in neither the block nor the head, and is lost on replay.
issues.detail: lastAppendID returns the highest appendID issued, including appends that are still open. The comment 'blocks are guaranteed to contain all samples with appendID <= watermark' fails for open appenders, because the block reader's isolation snapshot excludes them.

units.headline: Shared head-view compaction loop with append-ID eviction watermark
units.reason: New compaction/eviction logic that deletes data from the head; a race here causes data loss.
focus: Open appenders whose appendID <= watermark that commit after the block snapshot: are they still evicted?
gcSeries does not check pendingCommit, unlike regular gc
Using the global chunkRange for slices vs opts.ChunkRange for mint alignment
Callers holding db.cmtx; the test hook is global and not synchronized

units.summary: CompactStaleHead now delegates to compactHeadViewLocked, using a SelectedSeriesHead view and truncateStaleSeries with the watermark. Changes: no log line is written for empty slices, and the eviction predicate now also skips series with post-watermark appends.
units.headline: CompactStaleHead refactored onto shared helper with watermark guard
units.reason: Eviction predicate and loop behavior changed for an existing public compaction path.
focus: truncateStaleSeries predicate (no OOO, stale, no appendID above the watermark) matches the old gcStaleSeries semantics
Error text changed from 'persist stale head' to 'persist head portion'

units.summary: A comment in the test now says gcSeries instead of gcStaleSeries, following the rename.
units.headline: Test comment updated to the renamed gcSeries
units.reason: Comment-only edit in a test file.

units.summary: New test that injects a late append through the before-evict hook and checks the series survives eviction and a restart when isolation is enabled. It only covers appenders opened after the watermark, not ones opened before it.
units.headline: New test for a late append surviving selected-series compaction
units.reason: New test only; it cannot affect production behavior.
